scenario: Release and spill timing at dt = 1/60 s, loads exactly at threshold (pollen, nectar-only, mixed; both sides): swing start, release at BB_TIP_RELEASE_S, settle, per-step state; hiveTimerStep (releasing) and hiveStep (spilled).

inputs.kindOf: kinds list indexed by id; ids 0..n-1 initially, launches get the next id
inputs.launch_rule: recorder: a launch offered at time t_s is applied at step round(t_s/dt) (so launch times scale with dt; launches whose step is past the end of the run are listed in launches_not_reached_*; applied ones, with accepted flags, in launches_timer / launches_step). It is added iff hiveAccepts(hive, red, centre of taking cell, mid opening z, vel = {x:0, y:hiveApproachSign(taking), z:-10}); then that step is run. The add rule always aims at the taking-cell centre, inbound and descending, so these traces never contain a refused launch; refusal is covered only by capture.json. Each scenario is run twice from the same inputs, once with hiveTimerStep and once with hiveStep. A run stops 2 steps after the first tipped=true step (never for below_threshold), or at max_steps.
inputs.timer_steps_note: IMPORTANT: hiveTimerStep never clears contents (the caller does); the recorder keeps the tray full, so after the settle the timer run starts a SECOND swing (tips can reach 2 at dt 3 and 5 while hiveStep rows show tips 1, because hiveStep empties the tray at the release). Compare the two series only up to the first tipped=true. timer_steps rows omit hive.contents (hiveTimerStep returns it untouched; the recorder asserts it); step_steps rows carry it
inputs.initial_hive: contents = ids of initial_kinds, tips 0, tipping 0, released false, no swingRate key
inputs.key_note: a hive with no swingRate key means undefined (key omitted)
